##### Source: Dungeon Master's Guide (Ring of Jumping)

*Keyring, uncommon (requires installation)*

**Specs:** <1 lbs., $$55,000

While wearing this keyring, you can cast the *[hydraulic boost](/tech:hydraulic-boost)* tech from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself when you do so.
